limitations: JAX/XLA/Pallas require separate dependencies and were not GPU-qualified in this PyTorch environment.
sm90a/sm100a-only variants cannot execute their architecture-specific instructions on sm80.
No Anthropic bias-only DiT adapter; explicit request raises.
SWA uses upstream gather candidate K129 with torch RoPE, locally checked at BF16 D32 half-window64.
OPM module serves normalize-before-projection at C_z128; scalar OPM C_z256 core uses explicit upstream a1 tile.
All-masked APB oracle uses mathematical SDPA: torch2.13 fused fp32 SDPA returns zero for finite-min logits, while math SDPA returns the uniform average.
Primitive times are smoke qualification, not an interleaved backend performance comparison.
Original failed configurations are preserved in primitive_experiments; they were not silently substituted.
